QuestInfo.name: Finding Aran 1
QuestInfo.0: Lilin said she's been expecting you. She looks a bit grouchy, but you have to talk to her since she might know about Aran.
QuestInfo.1: Lilin rented a boat from Puro for you to take to Riena Strait, where Aran is. She told you to be careful of flotsam and other troubles along the way. Make your way to where Aran is.
QuestInfo.2: You took off in the boat that Lilin prepared for you. There were some close calls, but you arrived at Riena Strait safe and sound.

0.0: Aran's friend? Are you one of the heroes that fought the Black Mage hundreds of years ago? I see. Aran is... Well, I'll show you. Here, get on this boat.
0.1: I asked #rPuro#k for a boat to take you to Aran. Hop on.

yes.0: Just #rbe careful of wooden boards and other stuff in the ocean#k. Running into them might kinda sink your boat.

no.0: Um... I hope you're not wanting me to go with you. Do I look like I have free time?
